course_name: 進階英文閱讀與聽講練習
outline: This course guides students to develop their English conversation, reading, and critical thinking skills. Students will engage in presentations and discussions on various issues from Western young adult literature and American popular culture. They are also encouraged to critically examine these issues and relate them to their own lives.
